title: 587. Random Pick with Weight

examples.explanation: Index 0 has weight 1 and index 1 has weight 3; any in-range index is accepted per call.
A single index owns every pick.
Each index has positive weight, so each must be able to appear; any in-range pick passes per call.

hints: Build prefix sums once; each pick draws a uniform t in [0, total) and returns the first prefix strictly greater than t.
A binary search over the prefix array answers each pick in O(log n).
The judge checks index validity on every call (plus coverage on traces with 500+ picks), not the distribution.
